name: agentmanager
description: AI coding session orchestration dashboard — launch, monitor, and manage Claude Code & OpenAI Codex sessions from a web UI

scripts.build: npm run build:dashboard && npm run build:server
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:server && npm run test:dashboard && npm run test:update-security
scripts.test:coverage: npm --prefix server run test:coverage && npm --prefix dashboard run test:coverage
scripts.test:all: npm run test:coverage && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../dashboard && npm install
scripts.clean: cd server && rm -rf dist && cd ../dashboard && rm -rf dist
scripts.test:regression:conversation: npm --prefix server test -- --run tests/conversation-reader.test.ts tests/conversation-stream.test.ts tests/conversation-stream-recovery.test.ts && npm --prefix dashboard test -- --run tests/SessionConversationSend.test.tsx tests/conversation-timeline.test.ts tests/conversation-stream.test.ts && playwright test e2e/conversation-duplicate-input.spec.ts e2e/conversation-order.spec.ts e2e/conversation-reconnect.spec.ts e2e/conversation-history-replacement.spec.ts
scripts.test:regression:accounts: npm --prefix server test -- --run tests/codex-environments.test.ts tests/codex-account-details.test.ts tests/codex-account-transport.test.ts tests/codex-account-files.test.ts tests/codex-history-bundle.test.ts tests/codex-environment-transfer.test.ts tests/codex-environment-usage.test.ts tests/conversation-new.test.ts tests/terminal-worker-controls.test.ts && npm --prefix dashboard test -- --run tests/CodexEnvironments.test.tsx tests/CodexAccountProvider.test.tsx tests/ProviderUsageTable.test.tsx tests/ProviderDeleteDialog.test.tsx tests/ConversationControls.test.tsx && playwright test e2e/codex-environments.spec.ts
